info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Message Review Submission API
info.description: The Financial Message Review Submission API facilitates the process of submitting reviews for financial messages within banking transactions. This endpoint allows users to provide feedback or comments related to specific financial messages, enhancing the quality and reliability of banking services. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and financial service providers looking to analyze and improve financial messaging systems. By incorporating user reviews, organizations can make informed decisions to enhance their operational processes.

post.summary: Create a review for the financial message analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific financial message analysis identified by its reference ID. Provide the necessary details about the review in the request body to successfully create a review.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a review for the financial message analysis with identifier RES-100045. It contains the necessary data and parameters required for processing the review, which may include details such as rating, comments, and other relevant information related to the financial message.
